building.name: Builders and carpenters
building.desc: Residential and light commercial building, renovation, carpentry
profile: Licensed Building Practitioners carry out restricted building work?
Is restricted building work carried out by unlicensed staff under LBP supervision?

profile.hint: Supervision of trainees or unlicensed workers by a licensed practitioner.

profile: How is supervision managed and recorded?

profile.hint: Who supervises, how many people each, and how it is documented, including Record of Work.

profile: Share of work that is new residential building (%)
Written residential contracts with the required disclosure and implied warranties?

gen: Check LBP licences are current for restricted building work. A lapse or disciplinary action can affect cover and a claim.
Contract form, defects periods, retentions and who carries the risk for weather, delays and design.
liab: Long-tail defects
Building Act liability can run for up to 10 years and weathertightness claims are the classic example. Check retroactive dates, run-off cover and joint liability where others become insolvent.
pi: If the business designs or specifies, check cover for design errors and engineers’ producer statements.

plumbing.name: Plumbers, gasfitters and drainlayers
profile: Share of work in new builds (%)
Gasfitting includes LPG or commercial gas installations?
Certificates of compliance and gas safety certificates kept?
Work in occupied homes, rest homes or schools?
Work carried out under a building consent?

gen: Plumbers, gasfitters and drainlayers must hold current registration and licences. Ask about lapses and how certificates are recorded.
liab: Water damage and leaks
The common claim. Ask about pressure testing, backflow prevention, sign-off and the excess on water damage.
Gas and fire
Gas leaks, explosion and fire after hot work. Ask about gas testing and commissioning records.
Long-tail defects
Building Act liability to 10 years for work under consent. Check run-off cover if the business changes or closes.
Water damage after the job
Leaking joints, failed fittings and gas or drainage faults often show up after completion. Check completed-works cover and the PBWO extension for water damage.
pi: Do you design systems or specify products? Check cover for advice and any exclusion for faulty design.

electrical.name: Electricians
profile: All electrical workers registered and licensed, with supervision for trainees?
Share of work in new builds (%)
Certificates of compliance and records of inspection kept?
Solar, battery or EV charger installation?
Industrial, high-voltage or hazardous area work?

gen: Electrical workers must be registered and trainees supervised. A lapse can compromise cover.
liab: Fire from electrical faults
Electrical faults are a leading cause of fires. Check testing records, certificates of compliance and the limit for fire damage to customer property.
Solar, batteries and EV chargers
Newer installations bring product and fire risks. Ask about manufacturer warranties and installer accreditation.
Long-tail defects
Faulty work can show up years later. Check retroactive dates and run-off cover.

painting.name: Painters, plasterers and decorators
profile: Work on pre-2000 buildings where asbestos or lead paint may be present?

liab: Damage to finished surfaces and property
Spills, overspray and damage to flooring, cars and neighbouring property are the usual claims. Ask about protection and cleaning procedures.
Lead paint and asbestos
Older buildings can contain lead paint or asbestos. Ask about testing, safe sanding practice and who identifies the hazard.
mdamage: Solvent-based paints and thinners, rags and spontaneous combustion. Ask about storage and disposal.

roofing.name: Roofers
roofing.desc: Roof installation, repair, spouting and cladding
profile: Torch-on membrane or open flame used?
Share of work in new builds (%)
Work on older roofs where asbestos may be present?

liab: Water ingress claims
Roof leaks and water damage are the main claims, sometimes found years later. Ask about flashings, penetrations, warranties and workmanship guarantees.
Open flame and fire
Torch-on membrane and hot work have caused serious fires. Check permits, fire watch and procedures after leaving site.
Long-tail defects
Building Act liability for work under consent runs up to 10 years. Check retroactive dates and run-off cover.
Leaks and weathertightness after the job
Water ingress after roofing or cladding work is the classic defective workmanship claim. Ask about flashing details, membrane or waterproofing warranties and who inspects the finished work.
statutory: Falls are the main cause of serious injury in the trade. Edge protection, harnesses and training records.

landscaping.name: Landscapers and gardeners
landscaping.desc: Landscaping, lawn mowing, tree work and garden maintenance
profile: Tree felling or work near power lines?

liab: Property damage on site
Underground services, irrigation, windows hit by debris and plant damage. Ask about locating services before digging.
Tree work
Falling trees and branches, work near power lines and use of chippers. Check qualifications, equipment and any exclusions.
Spray drift and chemicals
Herbicide and pesticide drift damaging neighbours’ gardens. Ask about certification and records.
Retaining walls
Structural failure of retaining walls can lead to large claims. Check engineering sign-off and building consent.
mdamage: Mowers, trailers and chainsaws are targeted. Check security and the limit for theft from vehicles and trailers.

civil.name: Civil and earthmoving contractors
civil.desc: Earthworks, excavation, roading, drainage and heavy plant
profile: Number of excavators, trucks and heavy plant units
Work near underground services such as gas, power or water?
Work near waterways or contaminated soil?

gen: Values for each item, hired-in plant and the hire agreement obligations. Ask about theft, breakdown and transit between sites.
liab: Underground services
Strikes on gas, power, fibre and water mains are frequent and costly. Ask about locating services, dial-before-you-dig and potholing.
Subsidence and damage to neighbours
Excavation can undermine neighbouring land and buildings. Check removal of support, vibration and underpinning exclusions.
Pollution
Fuel spills, sediment into waterways and contaminated fill. Check the pollution exclusion and sub-limit.
fleet: Heavy vehicle licences, road user charges compliance, loads, tracking and driver hours.
mdamage: Check theft of plant from sites, basis of valuation, and cover for plant working under water or underground.

hvac.name: Heating, cooling and refrigeration
hvac.desc: Heat pumps, air conditioning, ventilation and refrigeration
profile: Share of work in commercial or industrial plant (%)
Design of systems or load calculations?

liab: Fire and leak damage
Faulty installations can start fires or leak, damaging buildings and contents. Check testing and commissioning records.
Refrigerated stock claims
Failed refrigeration spoils customers’ stock. Check the limit and any exclusion for loss of stock or business loss.
Design and performance
If you design or size systems, check professional indemnity for under-performance and design errors.

joinery.name: Joinery, glazing and cabinetmaking
joinery.desc: Joinery, aluminium and glass fabrication, cabinetmaking and kitchens
profile: Wood dust extraction and fire controls in the workshop?
Share of work in new builds (%)

liab: Weathertightness of installed joinery
Joinery installation affects the building envelope. Ask about flashings, sealing, consents and manufacturer warranties.
Glass breakage and injury
Large glass panes, safety glazing compliance and breakage during delivery or install.
mdamage: Timber, dust, finishes and solvents. Ask about dust extraction, spray booths, housekeeping and hot work controls.

scaffold.name: Scaffolding and access
scaffold.desc: Scaffold erection, formwork, crane hire and access equipment
profile: Scaffolds inspected and tagged on a regular schedule?
Scaffolds erected over public areas or roads?
Scaffold or equipment hired out without labour?

liab: Scaffold collapse and falling objects
A collapse can injure people and damage property. Check inspection records, load ratings, design for complex jobs and the limit.
Hired-out equipment
Hire without labour moves risk to the hirer. Check hire agreements, indemnities and the hirer’s insurance.
Public areas
Scaffolds over footpaths and roads need traffic management and consents. Check the policy covers public exposure.
mdamage: Values of tube, fittings and decking, theft from yards and loss in transit. Check the basis of cover.
